ORDINANCE.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 5-J in the area bounded by:

A line 210.76 feet north of and parallel to West Armitage Avenue;
the alley next east of and parallel to North Kimball Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel
to West Armitage Avenue; a line 188.75 feet east of and parallel to North Kimball Avenue; West Armitage

Avenue and North Kimball Avenue

to those of a Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2017 North Kimball Avenue, Chicago, DL 60647
